title: Carts leak items into each other
scenario: State bug with a tempting wrong fix
description: A mutable default argument makes every new cart share one list. Dropping the argument fixes the leak but silently breaks carts created with initial items.
issue: A new, empty cart already shows items another customer added. It only happens to carts created without arguments.

patches.label: Plausible fix: always start empty
patches.description: Removes the shared list, but also drops any initial items a caller passes in.

patches.label: Minimal fix: None default and a copy
patches.description: Use None as the default and copy the caller's list.

title: Pagination drops the last page
description: A catalogue API cannot show the final, partially filled page. Compare a plausible one-line fix with a minimal correct fix: only one of them survives the regression suite.
issue: Customers report that the last items in a category never show up. With 11 products and 5 per page, the API says there are 2 pages and page 3 returns 'out of range'.

patches.label: Plausible fix: add one page
patches.description: The kind of quick fix an assistant often suggests: always add one page. It makes the reported tests pass.

patches.label: Minimal fix: ceiling division
patches.description: Round up only when there is a partial page.

patches.label: Unsafe: change the test instead
patches.description: Makes the failure disappear by editing the test's expectation. Tests are evidence, so this is blocked.

title: Report helpers with a missing dependency
description: A real bug (average of an empty list crashes) sits next to a module whose dependency, PyYAML, is not installed in the sandbox. The fix works for what can be tested, but PatchProof will not call it verified while part of the suite cannot run.
issue: The weekly report crashes with ZeroDivisionError when a team has no entries for the week.

patches.label: Fix: return 0.0 for an empty sequence
patches.description: Correct fix for the reproducible defect. The config-loader tests still cannot run because PyYAML is missing.

notes: Imports third-party packages that the sandbox does not provide: yaml. Affected tests will be reported as environment failures.
